actual_visual_review.review_source: private_case_01.png through private_case_10.png from prelocked per-scene2 selection
observations: Projected PC/boxes and RGB ROIs have physical image support in all five scenes.
Examples include q1 on cars or persons when q0 is background, but visual association is a hypothesis, not GT identity.
Same visible car/person can remain in several complete-link groups; dedup reduces exact query multiplicity but does not guarantee physical instance uniqueness.
Several ROI crops contain adjacent cars, foreground/background, or only a person fragment; full-text CLIP is not proven reliable on relational descriptions.
Keep every skip and negative; do not tune config using these pictures.

decision: Proceed unchanged prelocked full5912 to measure pseudo quality and adaptation utility after seal; no deployment adoption.
